findings.highlight: Ah...before we go out to fight, can you promise me one thing?
findings.evidenceJa: 「……ああ。戦う前に、一つ約束してくれないか
findings.governingReading: The source starts a new quoted utterance and English retains only the final quotation mark.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s promise request loses its opening quote.

findings.evidenceJa: 地上であんな物を使ったら大事だし
findings.governingReading: 地上であんな物を使ったら大事 describes a disastrous serious incident from deployment on land, preceding the separate personal survival objection.
findings.explanation: The danger of using the sword on the ground becomes It’s important.
